Name: HxW 's Alternative Textures Furniture Depot
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://i.imgur.com/qTV5300.png[/img]

[size=5][center]Welcome to HxW 's Alternative Textures Furniture Depot! Here you can find AT packs for dozens of different vanilla (aka base game) items like furniture and craftables![/center][/size]
[size=4][i][b]Currently we have these AT Packs available for you today:[/b][/i][/size]
[size=4]
[b][color=#f4cccc][AT] H&W Bathroom Retextures for Vanilla Furniture[/color]
[AT] H&W Farmers Market Bakery Storage Pack
[color=#f4cccc][AT] H&W Farmers Market Core Storage Pack[/color]
[AT] H&W Farmers Market Fisher Butcher Storage Pack
[color=#f4cccc][AT] H&W Greenhouse Retextures for Vanilla Furniture[/color]
[AT] H&W Outdoor Retextures for Vanilla Furniture
[color=#f4cccc][AT] HxW Farmers Market Craftables Pack[/color]
[AT] H&W Fairy Garden Craftable Retextures
[color=#f4cccc][AT] H&W Fairy Garden Gnome Scarecrows[/color]
[AT] H&W Fairy Garden Retextures for Vanilla Furniture[/b][/size]


[b][size=4]Things to note:[/size][/b]

[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]These mods ONLY require Alternative Textures.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Unlike the CP versions of our mods, these may not have the same functionality or all available furniture options. This is due to limitations of base game item sizes and functions[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Many of these AT packs are set up using "Collective Textures" - that means if you are looking to retexture a chair, you should be able to use any chair to get the same textures! This hopefully saves you some time when looking for the rextexture you want.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Please look at the screenshots for examples of what the rextures do; you can always look inside the AT folder you've downloaded to see what items are retextured by reading the folder names.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]You can use any of these in conjunction with one another! So have fun decorating![/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
